description: Pre-flight check tool calls, terminal commands, or conversation history against SentioGate Armor security rules (credential leakage, destructive rm, pipe-to-shell, git force-push, and runaway tool loops).

arguments.description: JSON-encoded arguments or raw shell command string.

messages.description: Optional conversation messages array to check for stuck/repeating agent tool loops.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool (e.g. bash, exec_command, curl, send_email).

name: sentiogate_guard_check
